'''Manfred Niekisch''' (14 July 1951 – 11 November 2024) was a German biologist. He was professor for ''international nature conservation'' and director of [[Frankfurt Zoo]] (2008–2017).

==Life and career==
Manfred Niekisch studied biology at the [[University of Cologne]] and obtained his [[PhD]] (Dr. rer. nat.) at the [[University of Bonn]] with a study on the dispersal strategies of the [[yellow-bellied toad]] (''Bombina variegata'').<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Goethe-Universität — Kooperationsprofessur für Internationalen Naturschutz |url=https://www.bio.uni-frankfurt.de/45736070/Kooperationsprofessur_f%C3%BCr_Internationalen_Naturschutz |access-date=30 October 2023 |website=www.bio.uni-frankfurt.de}}</ref> 

From 1983 to 1989 he was director for species conservation of [[World Wildlife Fund|World Wildlife Fund Germany]] and the Wildlife Trade Monitoring Network [[TRAFFIC]].<ref name=":0" /> Between 1989 and 1998 he was executive director of [[OroVerde – Die Tropenwaldstiftung|OroVerde]], Foundation for tropical forests. In 1998 he became professor for [[Nature conservation|International Nature Conservation]] at the [[University of Greifswald]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2 February 2019 |title=Der Globalist |url=https://www.fr.de/rhein-main/globalist-11666069.html |access-date=30 October 2023 |website=www.fr.de |language=de}}</ref> This is the only university chair in German-speaking countries for international aspects of conservation. 

In March 2008 he became director of [[Frankfurt Zoo]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=News - Zoo Frankfurt |url=https://www.zoo-frankfurt.de/tiere/tierische-neuigkeiten/news/news/detail/zoodirektor-professor-dr-manfred-niekisch-geht-in-den-ruhestand |access-date=31 October 2023 |website=www.zoo-frankfurt.de}}</ref> At the [[University of Marburg]], the University of Hanoi, Vietnam and the Universidad Internacional de Andalucía in Baeza, Spain, he was lecturing on topics of international nature conservation.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sachverständigenrat für Umweltfragen - Homepage - Prof. Manfred Niekisch |url=https://www.umweltrat.de/SharedDocs/Personen/DE/2012_2016/Ratsmitglieder/Niekisch.html |access-date=30 October 2023 |website=www.umweltrat.de}}</ref>

In 2010 he became professor for international nature conservation at Goethe-University Frankfurt.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Redaktion |date=20 December 2017 |title=Frankfurts Zoodirektor Prof. Dr. Manfred Niekisch geht in den Ruhestand |url=https://www.top-magazin-frankfurt.de/leute-aktuell/manfred-niekisch-geht-in-den-ruhestand/ |access-date=30 October 2023 |website=Top Magazin Frankfurt |language=de-DE}}</ref> 

His scientific interests was both in strategies and instruments for the sustainable use of natural resources, aiming especially the conservation of biological diversity. 

Niekisch was the author or co-author of numerous publications. He was co-editor of the [[Journal for Nature Conservation]] (Elsevier) of [[European Centre for Nature Conservation|ECNC]]. Niekisch local focus is on [[Vietnam]] and the countries of [[Latin America]].

Niekisch died on 11 November 2024, at the age of 73.<ref>[https://www.fr.de/frankfurt/frankfurt-trauer-um-ex-zoodirektor-niekisch-93412299.html Frankfurt: Trauer um Ex-Zoodirektor Niekisch] {{in lang|de}}</ref>

==Memberships==
Niekisch was active in many voluntary functions, among others he was President of the German [[Society for Tropical Ecology]] (gtö). He was vice-president of the [[Frankfurt Zoological Society]] (FZS)<ref>{{Cite web |title=FZS Board of Directors and Foundation Board |url=https://fzs.org/en/about-us/fzs-board-of-directors-and-foundation-board/ |access-date=31 October 2023 |website=Frankfurt Zoological Society |language=en}}</ref> and Chairman of the foundation OroVerde.

==Publications (selection)==
* 2010: ''International conservation policy and the contribution of the zoo and aquarium community.'' – In: DICK, G. & M. GUSSET (Ed.): Building a Future for Wildlife. Zoos and Aquariums Committed to Biodiversity Conservation. S. 45–48, Gland
* 2008: ''Vorwort.'' – In: WWF Artenschutz. Die bedrohten Tiere der Erde. – White Star Verlag, Wiesbaden
* 2008: ''Aspirations and realities of the Biodiversity Convention.'' – Rural 21 The International Journal for Rural Development, Vol. 42 no. 2, S. 8–10. Frankfurt
* 2006: ''Countdown 2010. Schutz der biologischen Vielfalt.'' – Grünbuch Europa, Politische Ökologie 102–103, S. 49-52
* 2006: ''Marketing concepts for global conservation.'' – World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (Ed.): Proceedings of the 5th International Conference on Zoo Marketing and Public Relations, S. 34–36. Bern
* 2006: ''IUCN's Countdown 2010 Initiative.'' – World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (Ed.): Proceedings of the 5th International Conference on Zoo Marketing and Public Relations, S. 19–20. Bern
* 2002: ''CITES-Artenschutzkonferenz: Perspektiven für die Zukunft.'' - EU-Rundschreiben, Ausgabe 11/12.02, Dezember 2002, S. 10 - 12
